title: eDNA Extraction from Water Samples Using NucleoMag DNA/RNA Water Kit
author: Marine Vautier
materials: In this step, the buffers provided by the kit are distributed in a 96-well plate. For DNA extraction from filtered water samples, the 12 columns of the plate are divided into 2 sections of 6 columns each, allowing up to 16 samples to be extracted per plate. Annotate the 96-well plate as recommended below: Table 1: Recommended plaque annotation Note: It is useful to mark the dividing line between columns 6 and 7 with a marker pen to provide a visual cue for filling the plate. Add the appropriate buffers into the appropriate wells of the plate. 1 st column / 7 th column: Will be filled during plate preparation 2/2 2 nd column / 8 th column: 850 µL of MWA3 (1 st wash) 3 rd column / 9 th column: 850 µL of MWA3 (2 nd wash) 4 th column /10 th column: 850 µL of MWA4 (3 rd wash and bead drying) 5 th column / 11 th column: not used 6 th column / 12 th column: 50 µL or 65 µL of DNase-free H 2 O (DNA elution) Note: The choice of elution volume is based on the expected eDNA amount. The smaller the amount, the smaller the elution volume in order to obtain more concentrated DNA. Table 2: Plate preparation 1/2 Film and reserve the plate at Room temperature

steps.title: Preheat incubator and aliquot buffers
steps.instruction: Set the incubator to 70 °C. Aliquot kit buffers to minimise contamination: place C1, MWA2, MWA3 and MWA4 into 50 mL tubes; place the NucleoMag B‑Beads solution and DNase‑free H₂O into 2 mL tubes; allocate one 2 mL tube per sample for lysate collection, one 1.5 mL tube per sample for DNA collection, and one 5 mL tube per up to eight samples for preparing the NucleoMag B‑Beads + MWA2 mix.

steps.title: Prepare NucleoMag B‑Beads/MWA2 mix
steps.instruction: In a 5 mL tube (maximum eight samples) add only MWA2 buffer; the NucleoMag B‑Beads will be added later during plate preparation. Include a margin of one extra sample (e.g., prepare mix for nine samples if eight will be extracted). Refer to Table 3 for the exact volumes of MWA2 and beads.

steps.title: Lysis of Sterivex cartridges
steps.instruction: Perform mechanical and chemical lysis according to whether the Sterivex cartridge already contains buffer.

substeps.instruction:
If cartridge is pre‑filled with buffer: 
1. Retrieve the Sterivex cartridge. 
2. If frozen, defrost at room temperature for 10 min (00:10:00). 
3. Place the cartridge on a horizontal vortex and vortex at maximum speed for 5 s (00:00:05). 
4. Transfer the cartridge to the 70 °C incubator for 5 min (00:05:00) with automatic or manual agitation. 
5. Aspirate the lysate with a 5 mL syringe and dispense into a 2 mL tube (record the recovered volume, as it may vary). 
6. Centrifuge the tube at 11 000 × g for 30 s (temperature not specified). 
7. Return the tube to the rack and keep at room temperature until distribution to the 96‑well plate.

If cartridge is not pre‑filled with buffer: 
1. Retrieve the Sterivex cartridge from the freezer and keep on ice. 
2. Immediately add 900 µL of C1 buffer into the cartridge and shake manually. 
3. Vortex on a horizontal vortex at maximum speed for 5 s (00:00:05). 
4. Incubate at 70 °C for 5 min (00:05:00) with agitation. 
5. Aspirate the lysate with a 5 mL syringe and transfer to a 2 mL tube (note the volume). 
6. Centrifuge at 11 000 × g for 30 s. 
7. Return the tube to the rack and keep at room temperature until distribution to the 96‑well plate.

steps.title: Add mix and lysate to plate
steps.instruction: Prepare the NucleoMag B‑Beads + MWA2 mix for each well and combine with lysate:

substeps.instruction: 1. Vigorously vortex the NucleoMag B‑Beads tube to resuspend beads.
2. For each tube containing MWA2 buffer (prepared earlier), add the volume of NucleoMag B‑Beads indicated in Table 3; vortex the resulting mix to ensure homogeneity.
3. Remove the film from the 96‑well plate.
4. In the first and seventh columns of the plate add 500 µL of the NucleoMag B‑Beads + MWA2 mix to each well.
5. Add 450 µL of lysate (supernatant from the 2 mL tubes) to the same wells (see Table 4 for plate layout).

steps.title: Run MagnetaPure 32 extraction
steps.instruction: Place the prepared plate into the MagnetaPure 32 System, insert the magnetic rod cover, select the program matching the desired elution volume and temperature (Table 5). Note that elution at 56 °C improves yield but may cause evaporation. Start the run (approximately 40 min, 00:40:00).

steps.title: Collect DNA and store extracts
steps.instruction: After the run finishes, remove the plate and place it in the DNA‑workstation. Remove the magnetic rod cover and initiate UV decontamination as described in the instrument manual. Transfer each DNA eluate into a pre‑annotated 1.5 mL tube. Optionally measure DNA concentration and quality (e.g., Nanodrop). Store DNA extracts at 4 °C for immediate use, or at –20 °C or –80 °C for long‑term storage.
